title: My Challenges
description: Track your active trading challenges and manage your trade journal.
active_challenges_description: Monitor all your ongoing prop firm challenges and competitions in one place.
no_active_challenges: No active challenges yet. Visit the Challenge Library to get started.
trade_journal_description: Log and analyze your trades across all challenges. Track performance and stay compliant with prop firm rules.
journal_feature_tracking_description: Log trades for multiple challenges simultaneously. Each trade is linked to its specific challenge.
journal_feature_analytics_description: Win rate, R-multiple, profit factor, and more. Understand what's working and what's not.
journal_feature_rules_description: Real-time monitoring of daily loss limits, max drawdown, and consistency rules.
journal_feature_alerts_description: Get notified when approaching rule limits. Prevent violations before they happen.
